newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iranian President defends Islamists, attacks extremists.
- Morocco's King Hassan refuses to meet Israeli prime minister or return his calls.
- Moroccan banking sources expect interest rate cuts soon.
- Australian trade minister in Cairo on Sunday to discuss ways of developing trade relations.
- Kuwaiti Crown Prince Sheikh Saad to undergo a second operation. Sheikh Saad underwent a successful colon surgery.
- Iranian Foreign Minister Velayati to visit Saudi Arabia on Saturday as part of a Gulf tour.
- Filipino president to visit Qatar on Sunday to discuss gas supplies from Qatar.
- Morocco allocates 1.3 billion dirhams for infrastructure projects.
